name: GameCore
description: Events from GameCore (the game rules library), translated by the exe and delivered to the UI, renderer, audio and telemetry systems.

name: LocalMachine
description: App-local UI events: resolution changed, show leader screen, toggle grid, exit to menu, and similar. Not part of the game state.

name: Serial
description: Ordered UI and state events published in sequence: loads, saves, selection changes, option changes, network state.

name: UIEvent
description: Input and debug console events (`UIE_DebugConsoleInput` is id 15) and UI system updates.

name: Sequencer
description: Start-up and shutdown sequencing of the application states (init complete, main menu done, game view done).

name: MovieEvent
description: Movie playback events (clip finished, clip frame).
